Script Archive

Hi all,

I've created a simple site that you can download the scripts from: Click Here
If I violated anything in creating this site, please let me know.

I'm looking for people to give me screenshots for the scripts without them, and to correct/fill in any errors/blanks/screens in the descriptions/previews.

If you don't want to see 5 per page, or want to see all of them on a page, just type '?start=0&view=anyNumber' at the end of the address bar.
 
Comments welcome.

P.S. You can add your own scripts if you type something into the address bar...

Links: http://cheetah3d.freeweb7.com/

## #4 — Modeler — 2007-07-31
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/1996/post-13812>

Thanks for the comments. 

I've updated 'Mirror Copy.js'.

I also made a site addition: You can now add and edit scripts.  Just make the address bar look like "http://cheetah3d.freeweb7.com?moderate" or "http://cheetah3d.freeweb7.com?start=anyNumber&moderate" or "http://cheetah3d.freeweb7.com?start=anyNumber&view=anyNumber&moderate"

In short, just add "&moderate" on the end of the address bar if there's nothing after "http://cheetah3d.freeweb7.com", and add "?moderate" if there is somthing after it.

Then you'll see the word 'Edit' in each one, click on it and go down to the bottom of the page.  Here you can change anything about the script. If you just want to upload a picture, leave everything as is, but select a screenshot and press 'Add'.
